items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And that small group with [Otello?] playing…

ctx.x: Yeah. And I was just… I had had a stroke when I was [through?]. I had lost a lot of weight. And I was… the doctor said, “You’re okay but take it easy.” And then, Jaco calls me. “Papa. I want you to go to Japan with me.” And that small group with [Otello?] playing…
